free_text_notes.physician_note: 83-year-old woman with hyperlipidemia, atrial fibrillation, admitted 3/12 with small right cerebellar infarct. NIHSS improved from 6 to 2. The patient reports a mild seasonal allergy that is well controlled with an over-the-counter antihistamine. This was noted and confirmed to have no interaction with current medications. A standard nursing handover document was prepared on day 3, summarising the patient's stay for any community nursing team that may be involved after discharge. This was sent to the GP as a courtesy note.
